title: Bombastic Side Eye
blurb: Bombastic side eye. Criminal offensive side eye. The viral audio that finally gave judgemental looks a theme tune of their own, and immediately made every glance in every video legible. Play it over any look containing a full paragraph of unspoken disapproval: a pet watching you eat its treats, a colleague listening to an excuse they have heard before, a grandmother conducting a silent audit of your life choices. The sound does the judging so the eyes are not left working alone, which is a real service.
origin: A viral TikTok audio pairing dramatic vocals with judgmental looks.
